William Alves de Oliveira is a Brazilian footballer who was born on 31 October 1991 in Rio de Janeiro. His primary position is as a central defender. 

William Alves started his professional career at Paraná Clube in Brazil, where he played for the youth team. His first professional contract was at Atlético Paranaense in 2010. He then spent few years on loan playing for different clubs including Náutico, Botafogo-SP, and Santa Cruz.

In 2014, he signed with Santa Cruz after a successful loan spell, and has since become an important player for the team. He won the Campeonato Pernambucano twice with Santa Cruz in 2015 and 2016, as well as the 2016 Copa do Nordeste.

Despite being born in Rio de Janeiro, he is not affiliated or considered as a player of any of the famous Rio football clubs like Flamengo, Fluminense, Vasco da Gama or Botafogo.

As of 2021, William Alves is still a player for Santa Cruz Football Club. It's noteworthy to mention that while his primary position is as a central defender, he can also play as a defensive midfielder when required. 

As of this date, he has not represented Brazil at the national team level. His overall performance in clubs where he has played has been respectable, however, that has not been enough for an international call-up so far.
